decisions: The full suite is DEFERRED rather than run with failure classification when the open-red set is non-empty. Classification was evaluated and rejected: Go aborts a package on a build error, panic, or timeout, so a real unrelated failure inside a package that also holds an open red would produce no --- FAIL: line and be silently absorbed by the tolerated set - the exact hidden-unexpected-failure mode the gate exists to prevent. Deferral keeps compile/vet/lint/format repo-wide, runs every declared scoped command, records the deferral explicitly, and is bounded by a declared closing wave

green_maker_closing is {done} rather than terminal_success. archived satisfies a dependency but may be a descope (archivedFromDescopeEligibleStatus, internal/core/shipment_gate.go), so it must not discharge a green-maker obligation; a descoped green-maker leaves the entry open and the loop halts with WAVE_OPEN_RED_UNCLOSED rather than retiring a red no one made green

unsupported is defined as the COMPLEMENT of executable + terminal-success rather than as an enumerated list of remaining tokens, so the partition is total by construction and cannot fail open when the status vocabulary grows

The scheduler simulation is PowerShell + JSON rather than Go. The repository's test tree is Go-only and this cycle's scope forbids production Go; scripts/ already carries PowerShell, and a JSON fixture is parseable by CI, jq, and any reader, so the artifact is reproducible without a code change

The gate is FAIL rather than ADVISORY for the same reason cycle 31 gave, now applied to cycle 32's own changes: this cycle rewrote the status model, the manifest freeze anchor, and the convergence semantics, and the corrected contract has been reviewed only by the session that authored it
